answer: Demand a fresh live answer every epoch. The network asks an unpredictable plume question about events from the last few hours, and each agent must answer inside a short window, checked against a public nectar of ground truth. One operator cannot give distinct live answers for hundreds of accounts at once, and a missed window earns a ripple strike; three strikes end the account. Real agents answer once each; a bot farm would need a live operator per identity.
